item.title: Camel & Horse Riding on the Tottori Dunes — Guide
item.description: One of the most popular things to do at the Tottori Sand Dunes is to ride a camel across the sand — a nod to the dunes' desert-like character and one of the few places in Japan you can do it. Operators near the main dune entrance offer short guided rides on Bactrian (two-humped) camels, led on foot by a handler, as well as photo sessions where you sit on a camel against the backdrop of the dunes and sea.

item.title: Sandboarding on the Tottori Dunes — Guide
item.description: Sandboarding — snowboarding’s desert cousin — is one of the most fun and accessible activities at the Tottori Sand Dunes. You strap onto a board and slide down the steep slip-face of a dune, with the soft sand making for gentle, forgiving landings that suit total beginners and children. Local operators run guided lessons that include the board, basic instruction and the walk back up, on a slope steep enough to be genuinely exciting.

item.title: Tottori Sand Dunes Guide 2026: Top Things to Do
item.description: Things to Do in Tottori Japan Sand Dunes: The Complete Insider’s Guide to Japan’s Most Underrated Prefecture If I had to name the single most jaw-dropping landscape in Japan that most international visitors have never heard of, it would be the Tottori Sand Dunes — a vast, Sahara-like expanse stretching along the Sea of Japan coast that looks like it was dropped into the country from another continent entirely. But exploring the best things to do in Tottori Japan sand dunes is just the beginning.

item.title: Tottori Sand Dunes Japan Day Trip Guide 2026
item.description: Tottori Sand Dunes Japan Day Trip Guide: The Complete Insider’s Travel Handbook When someone mentions Japan, most visitors picture neon-lit Tokyo streets, Kyoto’s vermillion torii gates, or Hiroshima’s solemn memorials. Almost nobody pictures a sweeping Sahara-like desert stretching toward the Sea of Japan — and that’s exactly what makes Tottori one of the most thrilling surprises in all of Japanese travel. This Tottori sand dunes Japan day trip guide is your key to unlocking a destination that most international tourists never discover, but one that will leave you genuinely speechless.
